results.title: HIDDEN
results.overview: After the sudden disappearance of a loved one, a woman is haunted by a shadow from her past.

results.title: Married to the Filipino Mafia
results.overview: Meet the Filipino Mafia Family.  “Blood is thicker than water. We’re happy to spill yours.”  Marrying into this family? Good luck.

results.title: Life Sure Is Sweet
results.overview: Two years in the making, "Life Sure Is Sweet" is a independent coming-of-age snowboard documentary produced by the creative collective TDI (Technically Doing It). Featuring an all-Black and Brown crew of riders travelling and filming across the globe, the film moves beyond high-level action sports progression to explore deep themes of cultural identity, community, lifelong friendship, and charting your own path in the mountains.

results.title: Jamlitz: A Documentary Fairy-Tale
results.overview: The Lower Lusatian village of Jamlitz/Jemjelnica was once a thriving artists’ colony. Later, the Nazis built a concentration camp there, and from 1945 the site served as a Soviet special camp. Now Friederike, the great-granddaughter of an artist, returns, hoping to use her family’s creative legacy to revive the village and heal the wounds of collective memory.

results.title: De souche
results.overview: As immigration becomes more central than ever in political discourses, De souche offers a dizzying deep dive into the far-reaching tentacles of the “Great Replacement” conspiracy theory, which is gaining popularity across the Western world. In this illuminating documentary, journalist and filmmaker Simon Coutu travels across Québec and France, meeting a range of people who subscribe to or specialize in the subject. He examines the origins of this rhetoric, its harmful consequences, and its ties to the far right and white supremacist movements. A hard-hitting documentary that offers an essential critical perspective.

results.title: Spiwanje – co nas zwězujo
results.overview: Three people, one language: music. Singing activist Marek Slodička, music editor Gregor Kliem and harpist Karlina Margrafojc meet at the Zapust carnival in Jänschwalde, in the recording studio, at a concert and at a summer language course.

results.title: Journey to the End of the Ego
results.original_title: Journey to the End of the Ego
results.overview: The scene is the almost mythical landscape of Ben Loyal, one of Scotland's most remote mountains towering over the Arctic Ocean. The cliff is one of the finest sweeps of clean unclimbed rock to be found anywhere in the land. The climber is the thought-provoking controversial live-wire, who goes by the name of Franco Cookson. This is the epic story of the UK's most dangerous trad route and the 105 days of climbing it took to realise one man's dream; 'Nothing is Lost' E12 7a.

results.title: Rua 16
results.overview: Fed up with constant power outages caused by the utility company's negligence, the residents of Rua 16 decide to organize a collective effort to install solar panels and take control of their own electricity supply. However, internal disagreements and the fear of retaliation threaten the community's unity - even before the first panel is installed.

results.title: A Town Called Needville
results.overview: Told through 35mm photographs and first-person narration, A TOWN CALLED NEEDVILLE traces the filmmaker's four-month inpatient stay at an all-women’s mental health facility in Needville, Texas.

results.title: Crystal Apple: Unforeseen Consequences
results.overview: Psychic spies/jazz fusion artists Angelica Apple and Crystal Floredeliza go undercover as escorts to investigate the sale of alien technology.

results.title: Fortunes
results.overview: Marta travels upstate to reunite with her sister, but a stranger joins her along the way.

results.title: The Dungeon: West Virginia Penitentiary
results.overview: Ever since I was a kid I have been interested in the paranormal and now as an adult I can finally discover the truth for myself. I visited the West Virginia Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to see what I could find. Who knew that on my first investigation, I would get far more than I ever bargained for.

results.title: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B
results.original_title: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B
results.overview: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B explores the music scene from the Brazilian state of Ceará between 1969 and 1979 - a period marked by the military coup, the implementation of the AI-5 decree, and intense socio-political ferment. The focus is on the "Pessoal do Ceará" movement, which brought artists such as Fagner, Ednardo, and Belchior to prominence. Taking the 1973 álbum as a starting point, the work examines its common association with these three singers - even though, in reality, only Ednardo (alongside Rodger and Teti) is featured on it.

results.title: Douvina
results.overview: The film is a silent invitation to contemplation: on the winding paths of preserving memory, on what slips through our fingers in the present, and on our own place in the face of the departure of those we love, the disappearance of places, and the subtle marks we leave along the way.

results.title: Mono No Aware
results.overview: The spiritual journey of a human being -an idealized model, a prophet of purity- on the path toward the Nietzschean Übermensch, reinterpreted through a contemporary lens. From the social darkness of the Camel, taking its steps through a desert of melancholy and solitude, to the verbal force of the Lion, reflected in its absolute moral freedom and freedom of thought, up to the birth of the Child, the very manifesto of innocence, ruled by instinct, physical ecstasy, a continuous search for the Self, and constant linguistic experimentation.

results.title: The Whores Feast
results.overview: Filmed during a shared harvest dinner with organizers and collaborators, The Whores Feast brings together Ceyenne Doroshow of G.L.I.T.S., Victoria Von Blaque of Trans Equity Consulting, Lisa 张小华 of Red Canary Song, and Amalia Valentine of Decrim NY. Their conversation lingers over nourishment, labor, chosen family, honoring the collective practices of care that sustain communities through ongoing precarity.

results.title: Hit the Books, Harry!
results.overview: A stressed, under-prepared college student spots a girl across the empty library as he crams for his exams.

results.title: La Esquina tá en Candela
results.overview: When a man bursts into a grocery store armed and demanding to talk with somebody, an ordinary afternoon turns into chaos in the neighborhood.
